SELECT
  c.content_id, c.client_id, c.image_prompt, c.visual_description, c.generated_image_path,
  c.briefing, c.request, c.structured_output,
  v.id::text AS version_id, v.version_label, v.version,
  b.brand_name, b.business_type, b.primary_colors, b.secondary_colors, b.fonts,
  b.logo_path, b.brand_rules, b.restrictions, b.preferences,
  eo.operation_id::text AS existing_operation_id, eo.status AS existing_operation_status, eo.file_path AS existing_operation_path, eo.provider AS existing_provider, eo.model AS existing_model, eo.external_id AS existing_request_id, eo.cost_estimate AS existing_cost, eo.response_metadata->'usage' AS existing_usage,
  COALESCE((SELECT config_value FROM social_media.runtime_config WHERE config_key = 'image_provider'), 'mock') AS image_provider,
  COALESCE((SELECT config_value FROM social_media.runtime_config WHERE config_key = 'image_model'), 'gpt-image-2') AS image_model
FROM social_media.content_items c
JOIN social_media.clients b ON b.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id, version_label, version FROM social_media.content_versions WHERE content_id = c.content_id AND version = 1 LIMIT 1) v ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM social_media.external_operations WHERE version_id=v.id AND operation_type='IMAGE_GENERATION' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) eo ON true
WHERE c.content_id = $1
LIMIT 1;

WITH content_ready AS (UPDATE social_media.content_items SET generated_image_path=$3,status='IMAGE_GENERATED',updated_at=now() WHERE content_id=$1 RETURNING client_id,source_message_id), version_ready AS (UPDATE social_media.content_versions SET generated_image_path=$3 WHERE id=$2::uuid RETURNING version_label), event_created AS (INSERT INTO social_media.events(correlation_id,client_id,content_id,event_type,workflow_name,details) SELECT COALESCE(m.correlation_id,gen_random_uuid()),c.client_id,$1,'IMAGE_REUSED','04 - Geracao de Imagem de Produto',jsonb_build_object('version_id',$2::uuid,'file_path',$3,'operation_id',$4::uuid) FROM content_ready c LEFT JOIN social_media.messages m ON m.message_id=c.source_message_id WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM social_media.events WHERE content_id=$1 AND event_type='IMAGE_REUSED' AND details->>'version_id'=$2) RETURNING event_id) SELECT $1::text AS content_id,$2::uuid AS version_id,(SELECT version_label FROM version_ready) AS version_label,$5::text AS provider,$6::text AS model,$7::text AS prompt,$8::text AS openai_request_id,$3::text AS file_path,$9::numeric AS cost_estimate_usd,$10::jsonb AS usage,$11::int AS width,$12::int AS height,$13::text AS quality,$14::text AS product,$4::uuid AS external_operation_id,true AS persisted,true AS reused,false AS final_art_created;

WITH operation_started AS (INSERT INTO social_media.external_operations(content_id,version_id,idempotency_key,operation_type,provider,model,prompt,status,response_metadata) VALUES($1,$2::uuid,$3,'IMAGE_GENERATION',$4,$5,$6,'IN_PROGRESS',jsonb_build_object('version_id',$2::uuid,'product',$7)) ON CONFLICT(idempotency_key) WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE SET status='IN_PROGRESS' WHERE social_media.external_operations.status='FAILED' RETURNING operation_id), content_started AS (UPDATE social_media.content_items SET status='GENERATING_IMAGE',updated_at=now() WHERE content_id=$1 AND status IN ('BRIEFING_CREATED','IMAGE_GENERATION_FAILED') RETURNING client_id,source_message_id), event_created AS (INSERT INTO social_media.events(correlation_id,client_id,content_id,event_type,workflow_name,details) SELECT COALESCE(m.correlation_id,gen_random_uuid()),c.client_id,$1,'IMAGE_GENERATION_STARTED','04 - Geracao de Imagem de Produto',jsonb_build_object('version_id',$2::uuid,'provider',$4,'model',$5,'operation_id',(SELECT operation_id FROM operation_started)) FROM content_started c LEFT JOIN social_media.messages m ON m.message_id=c.source_message_id RETURNING event_id) SELECT $1::text AS content_id,$2::text AS version_id,(SELECT operation_id FROM operation_started)::text AS operation_id;

WITH context AS (SELECT c.client_id,c.source_message_id,m.correlation_id FROM social_media.content_items c LEFT JOIN social_media.messages m ON m.message_id=c.source_message_id WHERE c.content_id=$1), operation_failed AS (UPDATE social_media.external_operations SET status='FAILED',response_metadata=response_metadata||jsonb_build_object('error',$3,'http_status',$4::int),cost_estimate=0 WHERE idempotency_key=$2 AND status='IN_PROGRESS' RETURNING operation_id), content_failed AS (UPDATE social_media.content_items SET status='IMAGE_GENERATION_FAILED',updated_at=now() WHERE content_id=$1 RETURNING content_id), event_created AS (INSERT INTO social_media.events(correlation_id,client_id,content_id,event_type,workflow_name,severity,details) SELECT COALESCE(context.correlation_id,gen_random_uuid()),context.client_id,$1,'IMAGE_GENERATION_FAILED','04 - Geracao de Imagem de Produto','ERROR',jsonb_build_object('operation_id',(SELECT operation_id FROM operation_failed),'error',$3,'http_status',$4::int,'renderer_called',false) FROM context RETURNING event_id) SELECT $1::text AS content_id,'IMAGE_GENERATION_FAILED'::text AS status,$3::text AS error,$4::int AS http_status,false AS persisted_image,false AS renderer_called;

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({content_id:$('Preparar Geracao Dinamica').first().json.content_id,version_id:$('Preparar Geracao Dinamica').first().json.version_id,source_image_path:$('Preparar Geracao Dinamica').first().json.relative_path,expected_width:$('Preparar Geracao Dinamica').first().json.width,expected_height:$('Preparar Geracao Dinamica').first().json.height}) }}

parameters.query: WITH operation_updated AS (UPDATE social_media.external_operations SET external_id=$6,file_path=$7,cost_estimate=$8::numeric,status='SUCCESS',response_metadata=jsonb_build_object('version_id',$2::uuid,'usage',$9::jsonb,'product',$13,'width',$10::int,'height',$11::int,'quality',$12,'format','png'),created_at=created_at WHERE idempotency_key=$14 AND status='IN_PROGRESS' RETURNING operation_id,created_at), content_updated AS (UPDATE social_media.content_items SET generated_image_path=$7,status='IMAGE_GENERATED',updated_at=now() WHERE content_id=$1 RETURNING content_id), version_updated AS (UPDATE social_media.content_versions SET generated_image_path=$7 WHERE id=$2::uuid AND content_id=$1 RETURNING version_label), event_created AS (INSERT INTO social_media.events(correlation_id,client_id,content_id,event_type,workflow_name,details) SELECT COALESCE(m.correlation_id,gen_random_uuid()),c.client_id,c.content_id,'IMAGE_GENERATED','04 - Geracao de Imagem de Produto',jsonb_build_object('version_id',$2::uuid,'provider',$3,'model',$4,'product',$13,'file_path',$7,'request_id',$6,'cost_estimate_usd',$8::numeric) FROM social_media.content_items c LEFT JOIN social_media.messages m ON m.message_id=c.source_message_id WHERE c.content_id=$1 RETURNING event_id) SELECT $1::text AS content_id,$2::uuid AS version_id,(SELECT version_label FROM version_updated LIMIT 1) AS version_label,$3::text AS provider,$4::text AS model,$5::text AS prompt,$6::text AS openai_request_id,$7::text AS file_path,$8::numeric AS cost_estimate_usd,$9::jsonb AS usage,$10::int AS width,$11::int AS height,$12::text AS quality,$13::text AS product,(SELECT operation_id FROM operation_updated LIMIT 1) AS external_operation_id,(SELECT created_at FROM operation_updated LIMIT 1) AS created_at,true AS persisted,false AS reused,false AS final_art_created;
